The '''2021 West Sussex County Council election''' took place on 6 May 2021 alongside other [[2021 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]]. All 70 seats to [[West Sussex County Council]] were elected.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=election|url=https://www.westsussex.gov.uk/about-the-council/how-the-council-works/elections/electoral-process/#:~:text=The%20next%20County%20Council%20elections,electoral%20division%20in%20West%20Sussex.|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200213152716/https://www.westsussex.gov.uk/about-the-council/how-the-council-works/elections/electoral-process/ |archive-date=2020-02-13 |access-date=3 February 2021|website=[[West Sussex County Council]]}}</ref> [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] gained 4 seats in the Worthing division, while the [[Green Party of England and Wales|Green Party]] and [[Local Alliance]] gained their first ever seats on the council.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-05-09|title=Elections 2021: Conservatives hold Sussex county councils|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-sussex-57023007|access-date=2021-05-09}}</ref>
